## About
Premiere Auto Sports is an all-in-one shop on N. Sherman Dr. in Indianapolis for automotive upgrades, service, customization, fabrication, tuning, Ceramic Pro coatings, XPEL paint protection film, window tinting and dent removal. From general maintenance to performance upgrades, we work on import, domestic, luxury and exotic vehicles.
Our service department is made up of experienced detailers and certified and trained technicians. Recent projects include a Hellcat swapped Chrysler for Indiana Pacer Isaiah Jackson and a custom fabricated sidewinder turbo setup on a Ford Focus ST.
Reviewers mention John, Kaden, Pete, Krag and Tanner by name. The shop holds a 4.7 rating from 62 Google reviews.

## Services
- General Maintenance: Fluid changes (engine, transmission, radiator, differential), timing chain replacement, intake and cabin filters, accessory belts and brake rotor and pad replacement.
- Performance Upgrades: Basic bolt-ons, engine rebuilds, clutch/flywheel replacement, forced induction, nitrous setups and fuel system upgrades.
- Diagnosis: Troubleshooting electrical issues, misfire issues, mechanical issues and boost leaks on daily drivers and project builds.
- ECU Tuning: Tuning for brands including Audi, Bentley, BMW, Ferrari, Lamborghini, McLaren, Porsche, Subaru and Toyota.
- Subaru: Service, diagnosis and upgrades for the WRX, BRZ, STI and Forester, plus build packages for added performance.
- Ceramic Pro Coating: A liquid nano-ceramic coating that resists oxidation, stains, corrosion and scratches, applied to car or boat interiors and exteriors. Multiple coating packages are available.
- XPEL Paint Protection Film: Paint protection film packages that guard your paint against damage.
- Escort Radar Detectors: Custom integrated Escort setups, or hard-wired installs of standard window mounted units.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Use the free quote form with your name, phone number, year, make, model and service request, or call the shop.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: Import, domestic, luxury and exotic vehicles, from routine maintenance to full builds.

Q: Can I bring my own parts?
A: One reviewer said the shop let him bring in his own sourced parts, or have them shipped to the shop. Ask when you request your quote.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9AM - 6PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.

I appreciate Pete's ability to keep me updated on the project and relay well thought out and concise information to me over the phone. Kaden was very professional in telling me what happened to my vehicle and detailing everything that needs to be done, as well as recommending other replacement and upgrades that made perfect sense along the way. He was very patient with my coming to the shop like it's a day care to check on the car and the progress and just generally talk about the project and what could be done. When we decided to frankenstein a bunch of different year STI's parts together, he made it all look and work as if it were OEM right out of the factory, or honestly even better.
